caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device constructed primarily of wood, featuring a large horizontal cylindrical drum placed between two sturdy vertical supports. The cylinder, which is light brown in color, is mounted so it can rotate and is held at both ends by the vertical supports, each reinforced with diagonal braces. At the left and right ends of the cylinder, there are metal hand cranks (dark gray in color) for turning the drum. Wrapped around the central portion of the cylinder is a thick blue-gray rope, with one end of the rope extending downward. The base consists of multiple flat, rectangular wooden planks arranged in parallel, forming a stable platform for the rest of the structure. Metal bolts or fasteners are visible at several points where the wood pieces meet, especially on the base and supports. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Well with Movable Beam
